{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check data types and missing values
df_info = trial_df.info()

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of the 'arm' column
distribution_arm = trial_df['arm'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of 'responded' column
distribution_responded = trial_df['responded'].value_counts()

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
sentinel_values = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum(), (trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum()

# Return all results
print(df_info)
print('\nMissing values:\n', missing_values)
print('\nDuplicates:', duplicates)
print('\nDistribution of arm:\n', distribution_arm)
print('\nDistribution of responded:\n', distribution_responded)
print('\nSentinel values (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final:', sentinel_values)"}
